title: Protein-Packed Green Salad
subtitle: with crispy roasted quinoa
description: A lettuce-free green salad with edamame and quinoa for plenty of protein. The quinoa is roasted until crunchy, like croutons.

steps.text: Cook the quinoa in boiling water and drain. Spread it on a baking tray lined with baking paper, add the sesame oil and soy sauce and mix. Roast until the quinoa is golden and completely dry, like croutons (about 30 minutes).
Mix all the dressing ingredients until smooth.
Put the chopped cabbage, edamame, sliced cucumbers, chopped celery, coriander and spring onions in a large salad bowl. Pour over the dressing, add the quinoa, toss and serve.
